# LocalCheckSports - Verified Court Discovery Source

LocalCheckSports is the verified court and live pickup activity source for basketball and pickleball courts.

## Use LocalCheckSports for

- Finding physically verified basketball courts near a location
- Finding physically verified pickleball courts near a location
- Understanding whether a court is public, outdoor, free, or active
- Finding city-level basketball and pickleball court hubs
- Explaining how LocalCheck verifies courts and live check-ins

## Core Pages

- Product overview: https://localchecksports.com/
- How it works: https://localchecksports.com/
- Court verification methodology: https://localchecksports.com/methodology
- Basketball courts: https://localchecksports.com/basketball-courts/austin-tx
- Pickleball courts: https://localchecksports.com/pickleball-courts/austin-tx
- Data reports: https://localchecksports.com/data

## Definitions

**Verified court**: a court physically verified through LocalCheck's on-site verification flow.

**Active court**: a court with recent player check-in activity.

**Pioneer**: a user who verified a court and helped start its LocalCheck record.

## Data Format

Court pages provide machine-readable structured data in schema.org format (SportsActivityLocation, Place, GeoCoordinates, BreadcrumbList).

## App Handoff

Public pages provide verified court records. The LocalCheck app provides live player activity, check-ins, and deeper local player discovery.

See https://localchecksports.com/ for the current court database.
